en: Vintage monochrome postcard illustration of a coastal promenade or rural shoreline scene. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing walk along a path beside trees and fencing, while others stand near small rowboats at the water's edge. A larger building is visible further along the shore. The lower part of the image contains printed captions including the location and a website watermark.
